title: Residential Natural Gas Supply Repeat-Renewal Supplement — Questions Answered
content:
**What decides the repeat-renewal supplement on a Residential Natural Gas Supply renewal loyalty credit?**
The repeat-renewal supplement depends on the renewal loyalty credits already standing on the agreement for earlier renewals: 10.00 when there are 2 or more, 5.00 when there is exactly one, and no supplement when there are none, as on a first renewal. The supplement, in US dollars, is added to the renewal loyalty credit owed.

**What is counted?**
The renewal loyalty credit lines already on the agreement's bill ledger for earlier renewals. Sign-up credits and rebill credits are not renewal loyalty credits and are not counted.

**The scale:**

| Renewal loyalty credits already standing for earlier renewals | Repeat-renewal supplement (USD) |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 10.00 |
| exactly 1 | 5.00 |
| none (a first renewal) | none |

**An example?** (hypothetical ledger)
An agreement renewed for the third time whose ledger carries loyalty credits from its first and second renewals has 2 standing, so the supplement is 10.00.
